"""Regenerates keep_textures.h from OoT's N64 NTSC 1.0 gameplay_keep.xml (soh/assets/xml/N64_NTSC_10/objects).

Usage: python gen_keep_textures.py gameplay_keep.xml keep_textures.h
"""
import re
import sys


def main(source, target):
    with open(source, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        xml = handle.read()
    textures = sorted(
        (int(offset, 16), name)
        for name, offset in re.findall(r'<Texture Name="(\w+)"[^>]*Offset="(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)"', xml)
    )
    lines = [
        "#pragma once",
        "// Generated by gen_keep_textures.py: ModLoader64 bodies address OoT N64 gameplay_keep by offset.",
        "#include <cstdint>",
        "namespace pak {",
        "struct KeepTexture { uint32_t offset; const char* name; };",
        "static constexpr KeepTexture kOotKeepTextures[] = {",
    ]
    lines += ['    {0x%05X, "%s"},' % entry for entry in textures]
    lines += ["};", "}", ""]
    with open(target, "w", encoding="ascii", newline="\n") as handle:
        handle.write("\n".join(lines))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
